answer: Require every new agent identity to be sponsored by a distinct human whose sponsorship capacity is capped: one sponsor may back only a few agents, and posts a bond forfeited if any sponsored identity is later proven fake. A harbor operator cannot mint thousands of identities from one desk, because each fake needs a separate sponsor risking real loss. Like quartz that cannot be duplicated without new mining, and ivory that cannot be counterfeited without a real source, each identity must trace to a separate accountable sponsor, so Sybil scale becomes linear in compromised humans, not free.
